topic: Maintenance of O2 system, servicing and safety precautions
syllabus_extract: Maintenance of O2 system, servicing and safety precautions. Safety measures while handling /upkeep of gaseous oxygen system. Quality checks on pressurized gas cylinders.
specific_objectives: 23.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the need of oxygen systems, types of systems, working principles of components.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of O2 cylinder quality checks, safety valve inspection, and leak detection procedures with instructor supervision.
intro_questions: What are the primary safety risks associated with gaseous oxygen?
List three common types of oxygen systems used in aviation.
Why is oil contamination strictly prohibited in oxygen systems?

summary_questions: Explain the correct procedure for checking the hydrostatic test date on an oxygen cylinder.
Describe the immediate actions required if an oxygen leak is detected in the cabin.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between gaseous and liquid oxygen systems, focusing on maintenance requirements, to be discussed in LP 02.
